##### Project general facts

Barajeel Tower B by GJ Properties is the second landmark tower within the Barajeel Towers residential development in Ajman, offering a contemporary interpretation of traditional regional architecture. The building features a ground floor, five podium levels, and thirty residential floors, forming a strong vertical presence within the city skyline. Its design is inspired by classic Barajeel wind towers, expressed through warm sand-toned façades, clean geometric lines, and expansive glazing that enhances natural light and city views while maintaining a distinctive architectural identity.

Residents benefit from a well-curated selection of amenities designed to support comfort, leisure, and everyday convenience. The development includes a resort-style swimming pool, fully equipped health club, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and dedicated retail spaces within the complex. Additional features such as covered parking, high-speed elevators, and 24/7 security ensure a seamless and secure living environment for all residents.

The residences offer thoughtfully designed one- and two-bedroom layouts that prioritize space, functionality, and natural light. Interiors feature high-quality modern finishes, built-in wardrobes, large windows, and well-planned layouts that enhance comfort and practicality. Private balconies extend the living space and provide open views of the surrounding city, while kitchens are fully equipped and apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
